verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Sai is exposed to developers through a REST API, a Python SDK and an MCP server. They also list simulang-js and documented API endpoints (events, approve, machines), so official SDK-based integration is clearly offered. Missing for 10: in-depth SDK reference or install/usage documentation, multi-language SDK coverage beyond a single Python SDK mention, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
